notes: Sanctum of Calm Waters (M21): 'At the beginning of your first main phase, you may draw X cards, where X is the number of Shrines you control. If you do, discard a card.' Seat 0 controls the Sanctum and one other Shrine; seat 1 controls a Shrine (not counted). The Sanctum enters on turn 1 (after that main phase began). Seat 1's turn: no trigger (no answer is scripted, so any ask would fail the step). Seat 0's next turn: draw step (+1), the trigger fires, the controller draws X = 2 and discards the chosen Junk. Hand: Junk 1 -> 2 -> 4 -> 3.
